journal_documented_d1_d15_d19_lodo.note: Exact values recorded in JOURNAL.ipynb Cells 400 and 404 (4 corrected vibration features, Random Forest LODO)
journal_documented_d1_d15_d19_lodo.key_insight: Holding out Dataset 19 (1500 Hz, 10 MN/m stiffness) drops accuracy to ~49%, exposing cross-machine domain shift when training only on 500 Hz configurations (D1, D15).

journal_documented_apples_to_apples_5fol.note: Exact values recorded in JOURNAL.ipynb Cell 423 (StratifiedGroupKFold, 5-fold grouped by Omega_Depth, identical 5 vibration features)
journal_documented_apples_to_apples_5fol.key_insight: Under identical features and grouped CV, D1+D2+D3 and D1+D15+D19 yield comparable accuracy (~80.6%-83.6%), proving the earlier ~99% score stemmed from flawed setup rather than dataset choice alone.
